_comment: T-590 ZONE-ORIGIN / TERRAIN-REGION TABLE — the plumbing source of truth the continent program (T-592..596) grows. Each region maps region_id -> {origin, extent, terrain sampler, era, respawn, clamp}. T-593 (continent-scale terrain, phase 1) AUTHORS the P1 regions on the T-590 seam: (1) 'wold' (Heartwold) KEEPS the byte-identical 'wold_legacy' sampler and RAISES its clamp to the P1 envelope (±620 m ≈ 1.54 km², continent-plan §1.1) — the dressed core is unchanged, the walkable box grows outward to the T-309 mountain rim (T-587 edge dressing, not grey void). (2) 'ashmoor' (Ashmoor City) is the FIRST SAMPLER SWAP — its terrain.sampler now names 'ashmoor_flat', an era-2 urban-flat field that is byte-identical to legacy INSIDE the dressed spike hull (±70 m of the anchor) AND in the far mountain-rim band (beyond its ±550 m clamp), diverging to low-amplitude gaslight ground only in the newly-walkable mid band (the migration invariant is airtight — see test_terrain_field GOLDEN_GRID + FIXTURES). (3) 'greyrise' is a NEW era-3 region at a FAR origin (0,-1400) with its own 'greyrise_flat' sampler (modern arrival flat + the Old Keep heritage rise) and a ±560 m clamp — no walkable border to the Wold in P1 (rift/flight only), its clamp box sits in the unreachable gap past the Wold's -620 m edge. ORIGINS + terrain.sampler are MIRRORED as a const in terrain_field.gd (that field is shared client/server + must stay pure/byte-identical, so it cannot load this server-only file); test_world_regions asserts the two agree AND that every origin is a broadcast_builder.REGION_ANCHORS bucket. The crypt/Vault instance pocket at (+420,0) is NOT a region here — it is an instanced interior (instance_service), not an overworld zone. P2 (deferred): walkable inter-zone borders (pass/river/ridge) once adjacent zones are both built; per-region spatial index only if the region count grows large (the O(regions) nearest-origin scan is fine at P1's 3 regions).
